variants.hook_vo: I used to lose a sock every single laundry day.
variants.first_frame: Close-up of a mom holding one damp sock over an open washer.

variants.hook_vo: How does a pair go in and only one comes out?
variants.first_frame: Close-up of a single sock stuck to the washer drum.

variants.hook_vo: Seventeen single socks. That's my drawer right now.
variants.first_frame: Close-up of a drawer full of unmatched socks.

variants.hook_vo: One sock goes in the wash. Zero come out.
variants.first_frame: Close-up of a hand dropping one sock into an empty washer.

variants.hook_vo: The washer isn't eating your socks. The door seal is.
variants.first_frame: Close-up of a sock slipping between the drum and the door seal.
variants.bridge_line: So I found socks that stay locked together.
